title: Software Engineer II
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com http://OpenGov.com.




JOB SUMMARY

At OpenGov bold ideas ship daily and rapid iteration turns directly into measurable customer impact. We stay relentlessly aligned with customer outcomes while pushing the frontier of AI-driven software development, using cutting-edge AI tools and techniques to build systems that scale.

As a  Software Engineer II  at OpenGov, you’ll build best-in-class SaaS solutions that enable efficiency, transparency, and accountability within government agencies. As a crucial member of our engineering team, you’ll lead and deliver new features and improvements in a fast-paced, agile environment, utilizing modern technologies such as ReactJS, Typescript, GraphQL, and NodeJS in an AI first engineering culture.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Collaborate across the organization to understand and translate business priorities into shipped features delivering customer success.

 - Generate clean, efficient, and well-documented software following industry best practices.

 - Conduct thorough code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members for both Human and AI generated code.

 - Develop, test, and deploy high-quality software with minimum supervision

 - Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex technical issues.

 - Contribute to  continuous improvement and operational excellence

 - Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry trends to drive innovation within the team

 - Contribute to OpenGov’s Engineering culture of innovation, leading-edge technology adoption and quality
   
   


REQUIREMENTS AND PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

 - Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth, ambiguous environment

 - Experience 3 to 5 years.

 - Experience gathering and incorporating feedback from users, teammates, or stakeholders to improve the quality and usability of products or projects.

 - Experience working across the stack (frontend + backend) and comfort shipping features end-to-end

 - Experience building with AI-driven UX, agents, and workflow automation (direct ML experience not required)

 - BA/BS in a computer-science-related discipline or equivalent experience required

 - Demonstrate a strong understanding of data structure, algorithms




WHY OPENGOV?



A Mission That Matters. 

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust.  Some people say this is boring.  We think it’s the core of our democracy.



Opportunity to Innovate

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.



A Team of Passionate, Driven People

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.



A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.



Benefits That Work for You

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

 - Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families

 - Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions

 - Professional development and growth opportunities

 - A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

description:
Overview
The Windows Endpoint Security Platform engineering team is seeking a skilled Senior Software Engineer to help build the next-generation security framework that will empower our industry-wide ecosystem of security partners. This work is central to Microsoft’s strategy to modernize endpoint security through a more resilient, extensible, and open platform.

In this role, you will play a key part in designing and implementing a new user‑mode based architecture that enables partners to deliver robust endpoint protection solutions without relying on kernel‑mode drivers - a major step forward in improving OS reliability and reducing security risk. You will contribute to a platform that must deliver exceptional performance, reliability, and a comprehensive set of capabilities to defend against evolving enterprise threats.

This initiative is a top priority within Microsoft and carries significant visibility at both executive and industry levels. You’ll collaborate closely with teams across Windows and the broader security ecosystem, helping to shape the future of endpoint protection for millions of customers worldwide.

In Core OS, we are responsible for the Operating Systems that power Azure, Microsoft's Linux OS, the platforms for Windows Client and Xbox, and our Windows Server ecosystem – through all of these, we support every one of our cloud businesses and billions of customers around the world. In this era of ubiquitous computing, systems software excellence has never been more important for Microsoft. High quality, high-efficiency operating systems and platform components underpin everything we do as a company, from making our systems more reliable for our customers, to increasing our competitiveness by reducing COGS, to delivering new features and capabilities to delight customers – that’s all us!

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
- Collaborate with Microsoft Virus Initiative (MVI) partners to develop the next generation endpoint protection platform.
- Establish long term technical strategy and direction.
- Create and improve architecture designs for complex end to end scenarios that involve multiple teams and services. 
- Influence, lead, and collaborate effectively across leadership, teams, and organizations to drive outcomes.
- Fosters a healthy and inclusive team environment.
- Embody our culture and values.

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python- OR equivalent experience.

title: Senior Application Software Engineer
description:
Join the ECPRT engineering team within Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Networking to build distributed software spanning monitoring, AI-driven workflows, and media capabilities. Our platform supports evolving use cases across data center monitoring, remote operations, and media streaming.

We are looking for a software engineer with strong system design skills and hands-on experience building services primarily in Go and Python. In this role, you will own features end-to-end, make architectural decisions, and solve problems across application services, asynchronous workflows, and underlying infrastructure.

You will work closely with engineering and operations teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and maintainable software. This role offers the opportunity to influence the architecture of an evolving platform and contribute across both new development and production operations.

Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain services and workflows using Go and Python.
- Own features through requirements analysis, system design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.
- Make and document architectural decisions, evaluating tradeoffs in scalability, reliability, performance, security, and maintainability.
- Build asynchronous, event-driven workflows using NATS and related messaging patterns.
- Design for failure scenarios, including retries, timeouts, duplicate messages, partial failures, and service recovery.
- Develop APIs and integrations across monitoring, AI, and media components.
- Improve observability through actionable metrics, structured logging, dashboards, and troubleshooting tools.
- Investigate complex issues across services, messaging infrastructure, networking, and media processing.
- Collaborate with SRE and partner teams to improve deployment readiness and operational reliability.
- Contribute to design and code reviews, mentor engineers, and strengthen technical documentation and knowledge sharing.

Required Qualification
- Strong software engineering experience delivering and supporting production services.
- Proficiency in Go or Python, with the ability to work effectively across both languages.
- Strong system design knowledge, demonstrated through the design and delivery of distributed systems or backend platforms.
- Understanding of service boundaries, API design, concurrency, data management, and synchronous versus asynchronous communication.
- Ability to reason about scalability, availability, consistency, fault tolerance, and performance tradeoffs.
- Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, including investigating issues across multiple services.
- Experience with automated testing, version control, code reviews, and CI/CD practices.
- Familiarity with Linux environments and networking fundamentals.
- Ability to independently drive technically complex work, communicate design decisions, and collaborate across teams.
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
 
Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with NATS or another messaging, queuing, or event-streaming technology, such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or comparable systems.
- Understanding of message delivery semantics, ordering, persistence, acknowledgments, backpressure, and idempotent processing.
- Experience with media networking, WebRTC, real-time communications, or media servers.
- Familiarity with protocols and concepts such as RTP/RTCP, SIP, ICE, STUN/TURN, codecs, and NAT traversal.
- Experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into production services or building AI-driven processing workflows.
- Experience with monitoring platforms, telemetry pipelines, dashboards, or KPI processing.
- Experience with containers, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure, preferably OCI.
- Experience supporting operationally critical systems and improving their reliability and performance.

Join OCI Networking’s ECPRT team to build scalable services in Go and Python across AI-driven monitoring, remote operations, and media streaming. This IC3 role requires strong system design skills and end-to-end engineering ownership. Experience with messaging systems such as NATS, media networking, or WebRTC is an advantage.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
 
Security represents one of the most critical priorities for our customers in a world of evolving digital threats, regulatory requirements, and increasing technology complexity. Microsoft Security aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We are working to reshape security and empower every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that provides end-to-end, simplified solutions.
The Microsoft Security organization advances Microsoft’s mission and ambitions to help secure digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds across our customers’ diverse environments, while also helping protect Microsoft’s own internal environment.

title: Oracle EPM-EDMCS Senior Software Engineer
description:
About Sopra Steria

Sopra Steria, a major Tech player in Europe with 51,000 employees in nearly 30 countries, is recognised for its consulting, digital services and solutions. It helps its clients drive their digital transformation and obtain tangible and sustainable benefits. The Group provides end-to-end solutions to make large companies and organisations more competitive by combining in-depth knowledge of a wide range of business sectors and innovative technologies with a collaborative approach. Sopra Steria places people at the heart of everything it does and is committed to putting digital to work for its clients in order to build a positive future for all. In 2025, the Group generated revenues of €5.6 billion.

The world is how we shape it.

Job Summary:
The Oracle EPM EDMCS Techno-Functional Consultant is responsible for leading the design, implementation, and support of Oracle’s EDMCS solution. This position combines strong technical skills with functional expertise in data governance, ensuring enterprise data management processes are aligned with business goals. The consultant will work closely with stakeholders across finance, IT, and business teams to configure EDMCS solutions and integrate them with broader EPM and ERP systems.
 
Key Responsibilities:
- Requirements Gathering & Analysis:
- Collaborate with business users and stakeholders to capture functional and technical requirements for enterprise data management.
- Perform gap analysis to understand business needs and how Oracle EDMCS can address them.
- Provide recommendations for improving data governance, consistency, and accuracy.
- Solution Design & Configuration:
- Design EDMCS structures, including applications, views, viewpoints, and nodes, to manage hierarchical and reference data.
- Configure EDMCS solutions to enable data governance, approvals, and workflows for managing enterprise data across financial systems.
- Set up integration points between EDMCS and other Oracle EPM and ERP systems like EPBCS, FCCS, Oracle ERP Cloud, and external systems.
- Data Management & Governance:
- Define and implement data management workflows, validation rules, and governance processes.
- Work on the alignment and synchronization of master data between EDMCS and downstream systems.
- Ensure compliance with organizational policies and regulatory requirements for data governance.
- Technical Configuration & Integration:
- Develop integration solutions between EDMCS and Oracle ERP/EPM systems, utilizing APIs, data management tools, and third-party applications.
- Configure and manage data mappings, validations, and transformations in EDMCS.
- Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to system performance, integrations, and data discrepancies.
- Testing, Deployment & Documentation:
- Lead system testing efforts, including unit testing, system integration testing (SIT), and user acceptance testing (UAT).
- Manage data migration activities during implementation, ensuring data accuracy and completeness.
- Develop and maintain technical and functional documentation, including design documents, configuration guides, and user manuals.
- Post-Implementation Support:
- Provide post-go-live support for EDMCS, including troubleshooting, system maintenance, and optimization.
- Assist in training end-users on EDMCS functionality, data governance, and system workflows.
- Continuously monitor system performance and implement enhancements as needed.
- Collaboration & Communication:
- Serve as the point of contact between business teams and technical staff for EDMCS-related projects.
- Provide regular updates to project managers, stakeholders, and business leads on project progress.
- Conduct workshops, training sessions, and presentations for stakeholders and users.
 
Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Functional Expertise:
- Strong understanding of enterprise data management, master data governance, and data hierarchies.
- Experience with financial and operational planning processes, including budgeting, forecasting, and reporting.
- Hands-on experience implementing Oracle EDMCS in complex, multi-system environments.
- Technical Skills:
- Proficiency in Oracle EDMCS, including configuration of applications, views, properties, and workflows.
- Familiarity with Oracle EPM suite components (EPBCS, FCCS, ARCS) and ERP systems (Oracle ERP Cloud, Oracle Fusion, or others).
- Knowledge of data integration techniques using Oracle Data Management tools, APIs, and file-based integrations.
- Experience with scripting (e.g., SQL, EPM Automate) and integration tools (e.g., FDMEE, ODI).
- Soft Skills:
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to business stakeholders.
- Proven ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
 
Education & Certifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field.
- Oracle EPM Cloud certification, especially EDMCS, is highly preferred.
- 5+ years of experience in Oracle EPM/ERP implementations, with a focus on data management.

Any Graduate

Role is Open for Noida & Bengaluru location

All of our positions are open to people with disabilities.

title: Sr. Software Engineer - Enterprise Features & Orchestration
description:
About the Team The Enterprise team builds the control-plane capabilities that ClickHouse Cloud’s largest global customers—including financial institutions, enterprise fleets, and AI platforms—rely on to run mission-critical infrastructure at scale. We solve complex state orchestration, automated scheduling, and distributed system consistency problems across multi-region cloud environments.
What You Will Do

 - Design scalable models to configure, validate, secure, and audit settings across thousands of enterprise organizations and services.

 - Build reliable control-plane orchestration workflows, such as automated scaling schedules, backup/restore mechanisms, and cross-region provisioning.

 - Ensure distributed system consistency across multi-tenant environments, building automated reconciliation and repair paths for partial failures.

 - Own features end-to-end: from backend API design (Node.js/TypeScript) through the Console UI, public APIs, and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) support.

What We Are Looking For

 - Experience: 6+ years in software engineering, with deep experience in cloud control planes, provisioning layers, or workflow engines.

 - Core Stack: Strong TypeScript and Node.js backend capabilities, with comfort shipping React UI and working with document/relational stores (PostgreSQL, MongoDB).

 - Control-Plane Mechanics: Hands-on experience building systems that manage desired vs. actual state, idempotency, retries, and scheduled jobs.

 - Cloud & Security Fluency: Familiarity with AWS/GCP IAM, cross-account access, encryption/KMS, and enterprise requirements like BYOC (Bring Your Own Cloud) or VPC peering.

Ideal Backgrounds: Managed database/data platform control planes (e.g., MongoDB Atlas, Snowflake, Confluent Cloud, Elastic Cloud, CockroachDB) or developer platforms (e.g., Temporal, Vercel, Fly.io http://Fly.io, HashiCorp).


PERKS

 - Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

 - Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

 - Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

 - Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

 - A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

 - Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.


CULTURE - WE ALL SHAPE IT

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here https://clickhouse.com/company/careers. Check out our blog posts https://clickhouse.com/blog or follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/clickhouseinc/life/0c1ee7f4-2129-488d-b413-e7f6270659fd/?viewAsMember=true to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

title: SDE II, Amazon Business India
description:
Are you excited by the challenge of launching new business initiatives for Amazon in India?
India Consumer Technology (ICT) team builds products and services that solve unique customer needs in Amazon’s fastest growing marketplace. We are a multi-billion dollar business with a huge potential to grow in a trillion dollar market. Our engineers own the complete consumer and seller experience for Amazon India, work on a wide range of technologies (including AWS and EC2) and build and operate highly scalable, low latency mobile first products and services. We are solving Know Your Customer(KYC), last mile engineering challenges around Mobile, Product Discovery, Delivery, Payments, Logistics, Customer experience, Seller experience and more.
As a Software Engineer within Amazon India Business team, you will be responsible for designing, developing and deploying solutions to help Amazon significantly expand its selection and drive improved customer experience by enabling a new fulfillment pipeline. This is a rare opportunity to be part of a team that will be responsible for building a successful, sustainable and strategic business for Amazon, from the ground up!
If you are looking for an opportunity to build creative technology solutions that positively impact hundreds of millions of international customers, and relish large ownership and diverse technologies, join our team today! You will work with Principal/Senior Engineers in the team to evolve the design and architecture of the products owned by this team. You will be responsible to set up and hold a high software quality bar besides providing technical direction to a highly technical team of Software Engineers.
As part of this team you will work to ensure Amazon.in is FAST and has the best shopping experience. It’s a great opportunity to develop and enhance experiences for Mobile devices first. You will be working on a work on a wide range of technologies including AWS EC2, SQS, Amazon WW platforms, ElastcicSearch, Big Data, Machine Learning, Android, iOS, Amazon Horizonte, JavaScript, React JS to create unique experiences for India retail customers. 
You will work on analyzing the latency across the various Amazon.in pages using RedShift, MapReduce, Java, Elastic Search and Machine Learning. You will get the opportunity to code on almost all key pages on retail website building features and improving business metrics. You will also contribute reducing latency for customers by reducing the bytes on wire and adapting the UX based on network bandwidth. You will be part of a team that obsesses about the performance of our customer’s experience and enjoy flexibility to pursue what makes sense. Come enjoy an exploratory and research oriented team of Cowboys working in a fast paced environment, who are always eager to take on big challenges.
 Position Responsibilities: 
 - Work closely with senior engineers to design, implement and deploy applications that impact the Amazon.in business with an emphasis on Mobile, Payments, and e-Commerce website development.
 - Own the delivery of an integral piece of a system or application.
 - Management and execution against project plans and delivery commitments
 - Assist directly and indirectly in the continual hiring and development of technical talent.
 - Create and execute appropriate quality plans, project plans, test strategies and processes for development activities in concert with business and project management efforts.

 Candidate will be a leader, quick learner and be able to work independently. He/she should be able to operate in a very fast paced environment where time to hit market is super critical. The candidate will need to balance technical leadership and savvy with strong business judgment to make the right decisions about technology choices.

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Software Development Engineer III, Alexa 3P Experiences, Alexa 3P Experiences
description:
Alexa+ is Amazon's next-generation personal assistant powered by generative AI – more conversational, smarter, personalized, and built to get things done on any device.

The Alexa 3P Experiences team is on a mission to expand what Alexa+ can do for customers by building consumer-facing experiences with trusted third-party partners like Thumbtack, Yelp, Uber and more. Using frontier AI technologies – including Large Language Models (LLMs), Model Context Protocol (MCP), and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) capabilities – we create agentic experiences that connect customers with an ever-expanding selection of services through natural conversation.

As a Senior SDE on this team, you will lead the design and architecture of category-defining experiences and category-scaling SDKs – reusable frameworks that enable partners to build sophisticated experiences with minimal effort. You will take a long-term view of system architecture, drive engineering best practices, and make technical trade-offs that balance speed of delivery with scalability and operational excellence. You will mentor engineers, influence technical direction across the org, and work directly with product, design, and partner teams to shape how millions of customers discover and interact with 3P services on Alexa+.

We're a team that moves fast, builds with AI-native technologies, and measures success by customer impact. If you want to lead at the intersection of generative AI and consumer experiences, this is the place.

Key job responsibilities
– Leading the design and architecture of consumer-facing 3P experiences and agentic Experts that enable customers to complete tasks through trusted partners on Alexa+
– Owning the technical vision and architecture for category scaling frameworks that enable partners to build sophisticated experiences with minimal effort
– Taking a long-term view of system architecture, proactively identifying deficiencies and proposing larger initiatives to improve scalability and reliability
– Making sound technical trade-offs that balance speed of delivery with operational excellence, security, and long-term maintainability
– Driving engineering best practices and setting standards across the team and broader org
– When confronted with discordant views, finding the best path forward and building consensus across engineering, product, and partner teams
– Mentoring and developing engineers, raising the technical bar and improving engineering practices across the organization

A day in the life
A typical day might start with a design review where you're guiding the team through architectural trade-offs for a new category experience. You'll spend time mentoring engineers, unblocking technical challenges, and driving alignment with product and partner teams. The afternoon is a mix of deep technical work – writing code, reviewing CRs, and prototyping solutions – balanced with strategic thinking on how to scale the team's systems and processes. We are a fun, close-knit team where everyone is ready to roll up their sleeves and help each other out, push boundaries, and have fun doing it!

About the team
Alexa 3P Experiences is a dedicated organization within Alexa Domains, purpose-built to rapidly expand the choices and selection of agentic experiences on Alexa+. Building on early launches with marquee partners, our mission is to offer customers choice and expanded selection in Alexa's agentic capabilities – positioning Alexa to lead in the next generation of ambient AI interactions. We work closely with cross-functional teams across Alexa for core platform capabilities while owning the end-to-end consumer experience and category innovation.

title: Software Engineer - Full Stack
description:
Job Description

Real estate runs on some of the most valuable and least modernized software in the world. MRI is rebuilding its foundations as a unified platform of services, data and AI. Your job is to build the layer people actually touch: the applications, workflows and AI-native interfaces built on top of it.
You will not be handed a ticket queue. You will be handed a real problem, a strong team around you, and the room to decide how it gets built. The platform services are being built so that you can move fast on top of them, and the best engineers will grow into technical leaders quickly.

What you will do

- Design, build and ship customer-facing web applications and workflows, from architecture to production.
- Own the quality of what you ship: frontend, APIs, data access, performance, security, accessibility and reliability.
- Build AI-native experiences: conversational interfaces, agent-driven workflows and copilots that act on real customer data.
- Help set engineering standards: design system, code review, testing, CI/CD and observability.
- Contribute to architecture decisions and write down the trade-offs so others can build on them.
- Learn from senior engineers, mentor those who join after you, and take on technical leadership as you grow.
- Work directly with product, design and domain experts, so the thing you ship is the thing customers need.
- Prototype fast, then harden turn a promising idea into a product that runs at global scale.

Required

- Premier Institutes - Bachelor's, Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field.
- 2 to 5 years of experience building software. Experience is not the bar: we welcome freshers with exceptional academics and a portfolio to show for it.
- Solid full stack fundamentals: modern TypeScript and React (or equivalent) on the frontend, and at least one strong Back-end language and framework (Node, Python, Java or .NET).
- Strong computer science foundations: data structures, algorithms, databases, networking and operating systems.
- Good instincts for API and system design, and a habit of testing and measuring your work.
- Evidence of building real things: shipped products, internships, open-source work, hackathon or competition results, or substantial personal projects (a GitHub or portfolio link is expected).
- Clear communication and sound judgment, including the ability to explain a trade-off to a non-engineer.

Strong plus

- Hands-on experience integrating LLMs: retrieval, tool use, agents, evaluation and guardrails.
- Cloud-native experience (Azure or AWS), containers and CI/CD.
- Experience with enterprise SaaS, identity and security, or regulated data.
- Design-system or micro-frontend experience.
- Domain interest in Real estate, finance or proptech.

What great looks like

You care about the pixel and the query plan. You would rather delete code than defend it. You learn faster than the job description expects, and you want to build something that lasts.

Why join

- Real ownership: take on meaningful product areas early, not a corner of someone else's roadmap.
- A greenfield foundation: build on a modern platform and AI stack instead of working around legacy.
- Global scale: your work reaches customers across the world's real estate portfolios.
- Access to leadership: work close to the architecture and innovation team and see your decisions land.
- A senior peer group: strong engineers, data scientists and product leaders who expect your best thinking, and who will help you grow.

Benefits:

- Hybrid working arrangements - 3 days in a week in office
- Annual performance-related bonus
- 6x Flexi any day: knock 2.5 hours off your day on any day.
- Medical insurance coverage for extended family members.
- Engaging, fun & inclusive culture: check out the MRI Software APAC Insta feed and stories!

About Us
 
From the day we opened our doors, MRI Software has built flexible, game-changing real estate software that powers thriving communities and helps make the world a better place to live, work and play. Fulfilling that mission is only possible because of one thing: exceptional people. People like you!  
 
Our people-first approach to PropTech is defining a new industry standard for client experiences that, quite frankly, can’t be duplicated. Experiences that deliver real value every day. And we know those experiences begin with our people. 
 
We believe MRI is more than just a workplace; it’s a connected community of people who truly feel they belong. Whether we’re investing in employee resource groups or providing tailored resources for each person to reach their full potential, we’re passionate about creating a work environment that makes you excited to show up every single day. 
 
At MRI, one of our core values is to strive to amaze.  From the intelligent solutions we create to the culture we cultivate, that’s our goal every day. Because that’s what industry leaders do. Whether you’re joining as a new Pride member or rejoining us after a short time away, your talent is vital to us, our partners and our clients. 
 
Amazing growth requires amazing employees. Are you up to the challenge?   
We know confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting remarkable candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply. We’d love to hear from you!   
 
MRI is proud to be an inclusive employer. We welcome and celebrate diversity across all backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, military, veteran status and more. 
We believe that Belonging is a direct result of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion. Those values are woven into the fabric of who we are and are foundational to our continued success. Come and see for yourself!

description:
Location: Noida

Role:

We are looking for a hands-on Principal Full Stack Architect (Node.Js) based to own the design and evolution of a cloud-native platform built on NestJS (TypeScript) backend and Next.JS (Frontend), Postgres SQL, Bull MQ, Redis and Microsoft Azure. You will define how our services provision, configure and manage Azure resources through an ARM-based control plane, and set the standards for reliable asynchronous processing – queue-driven workflows, idempotent operations, retries and failure recovery – across multiple engineering teams.

Key Responsiblilties:

This is an architecture-and-delivery role: you are responsible to lead the project, face the customer, gather the requirement and lead the development team, you will produce clear designs, review and shape critical code, and mentor engineers, write and review code and while remaining close enough to the code to prototype and validate your decisions.

Core Architecture & platform design responsibilities:

• Define the target architecture for NestJS microservices and APIs on Azure (App Service, Container Apps, AKS, Functions), including module boundaries, shared libraries, configuration and deployment topology.
• Establish API design standards (REST/OpenAPI, versioning, pagination, error models, long-running operation contracts) and enforce them through reviews and tooling.
• Drive non-functional design: scalability, availability, multi-region/DR, cost efficiency, observability and security by default.

Queue, messaging & idempotency patterns Architecture Design Criteria:

• Architect asynchronous workflows on Azure Service Bus, Storage Queues, Event Grid and Event Hubs; choose the right broker and semantics (at-least-once, ordering via sessions, dead-lettering, TTL, scheduled delivery).
• Define and standardise idempotency: idempotency keys, deduplication windows, idempotent consumers, inbox/outbox, transactional outbox with the database, and exactly-once-effect designs.
• Design retry and failure handling: exponential backoff with jitter, poison-message handling, circuit breakers, compensating actions (saga), and replay tooling.
• Apply durable orchestration patterns (Durable Functions or equivalent) for long-running, multi-step provisioning with correct state, timeouts and cancellation.

Leadership & delivery

• Author architecture decision records (ADRs), HLD/LLD documents and reference implementations; lead design reviews.
• Mentor senior engineers, raise engineering standards, and partner with product, security, SRE and FinOps stakeholders.
• Guide CI/CD (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions), IaC pipelines, testing strategy (unit, contract, integration, chaos) and production readiness reviews.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About the job
Experience: 3-5 years
Position: Individual contributor; senior backend engineer
Reporting to: CTO

Superlaw is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to build and improve the backend systems that power our AI products for legal and governance workflows.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role combining Python development, backend service and API design, and ownership of reliable software delivery. You'll work directly with the CTO and the product and engineering teams to take features from requirements to release, and grow toward independently owning core parts of our backend.

About Superlaw
Superlaw builds AI solutions for legal and governance workflows, with an initial focus on the insurance sector. Our products include an AI assistant, drafting engine, and an intelligence layer that integrates into customers' existing systems.

Our platform spans multiple services, data stores, and external integrations. Success requires clean design, careful engineering, and consistent follow-through.

What you'll do

Build and maintain backend services
- Develop and maintain backend applications and services, primarily in Python.
- Design and build APIs that connect our frontend, internal services, and external systems.
- Work with databases, data models, and queries to support product functionality and efficient data access.
- Coordinate integrations with external systems alongside the CTO and technical team.

Improve reliability and code quality
- Write clean, maintainable code, backed by automated tests and clear technical documentation.
- Debug issues, investigate performance bottlenecks, and improve the reliability of existing systems.
- Participate in code reviews and apply good practices for authentication, access controls, and secure data handling.

Take ownership and collaborate
- Own backend features from requirements through implementation, testing, release, and ongoing improvement.
- Work with the CTO, frontend engineers, and product team to define technical approaches, agree on interfaces, and resolve dependencies.
- Communicate progress, technical decisions, and delivery risks clearly.

The CTO will initially lead architecture direction and final technical decisions. You'll own the implementation, quality, and delivery of the features assigned to you.

What we're looking for

- 3-5 years of professional software engineering experience, including hands-on backend development.
- Strong proficiency in Python as your primary language, with experience building and maintaining backend applications or services.
- Hands-on experience with Docker and Git, including containerised development and collaborative version control.
- Demonstrated ability to build and integrate APIs, with a solid understanding of request handling, validation, and error handling.
- Working knowledge of databases, data modelling, and writing efficient queries.
- Evidence of writing readable, maintainable code and working with automated testing, debugging, and code reviews.
- Strong grasp of backend fundamentals, including performance, reliability, and application security.
- Strong written and spoken communication, with the ability to explain technical decisions to technical and non-technical teammates.
- Strong ownership, disciplined follow-through, and comfort working independently in an early-stage startup.

Experience that would be particularly valuable
- Exposure to Go (Golang).
- Familiarity with cloud environments and automated build, testing, and deployment workflows.
- Experience with background tasks, asynchronous processing, or integrations with external services.
- Experience integrating AI capabilities into software products.

You don't need to meet every preferred qualification. We value relevant results, curiosity, sound judgment, and ownership.

Why join Superlaw?
- Work directly with the CTO and contribute to decisions about how our backend systems are built.
- Take ownership of meaningful features and see them through to use in the product.
- Build expertise in AI solutions for legal and governance workflows.
- Help improve engineering practices, code quality, and the reliability of a growing platform.
- Grow toward owning core backend systems and, as the business scales, technical leadership.

How to apply
Apply through LinkedIn with your resume. Include a brief note describing a backend system or feature you've worked on, your specific contribution, and why you want to help build Superlaw. You're welcome to share a GitHub profile or relevant project links.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About Zamp:

Mission -

Zamp is not a company, we’re a humanity catalyst. We’re on a mission to enable people to move at the speed of thought.

This decade, we’re focused on building digital employees for the future of work, unlocking human creativity at a scale the world has never seen. We work with 50+ top global organizations and banks (including DoorDash, Uber, and Stripe) with billions in revenue. We raised a $22M seed round in 2022 from Sequoia Capital, Dara Khosrowshahi (CEO, Uber), Tony Xu (CEO, DoorDash), and other global leaders.

One aspect of our purpose is to build what we believe to be the world’s best team, passionate, authentic, and relentlessly curious people who want to do their life’s best work, learn as much as possible, and create outsized impact.

Hear more from our founders on our company here.

Role Overview:

At Zamp, our engineering team is the force behind our technological innovations. Transforming the most ambitious ideas into reality, we breathe life into dreams through code and hardware. With the right mix of expertise and creativity, this team is the unseen magicians who add a dash of tech wizardry to make Zamp’s products shine.
From coding late into the night to brainstorming over a cup of coffee, we are always on a mission to make our technology stand out. We are not just the engineering team but the tech superheroes that keep Zamp at the forefront of innovation.

What you'll do :

- Designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality, secure, software solutions that adhere to basic engineering principles such as Gang of Four principles, SOLID, and DRY.
- Collaborating with functional teams to understand requirements and translate them into technical designs and implementation plans.
- Utilising your expertise in our engineering stack, which includes Golang, Redis, message queues like Kafka and Pubsub, Kubernetes (K8s), and job schedulers.
- Shipping technically robust, scalable, and extendable platforms by applying best practices and ensuring code quality through testing, code reviews, and continuous integration.
- Identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks and other technical issues to ensure optimal system performance.
- Staying updated with the latest industry trends and technologies, and actively contributing to the improvement of our engineering practices.

Qualifications Required:

- 4-7 years of experience as a Software Engineer, with a strong track record of shipping technically robust, scalable, and extendable platforms
- Strong grasp of basic engineering principles, including Gang of Four principles, SOLID, and DRY
- Proficiency in our engineering stack: Go Lang, Redis, Kafka/Pub/Sub, Kubernetes (K8s), and job schedulers.
- Proven ability to solve complex technical problems and make sound technical decisions
- Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
- Customer-obsessed mindset with a passion for simplifying complex problems in the fintech space.
- Demonstrated empathy and strong teamwork skills, fostering a collaborative and supportive work environment.

Good to have:

- You are an entrepreneur at heart, i.e you are not only excited about startups but also really understand what it is like to work in one
- You are excited to learn new things and do not shy away from going above and beyond the traditional growth paths. You have strong communication skills.
- You can quickly adapt to the changing environment and are quick to pick up new skills if required to get the job done.
- You have the ability to break down a problem into smaller chunks and the ability to balance between the big picture and tactical activities.

Our Culture and Benefits: 

At Zamp, we promote a culture of open communication, collaboration, and empowerment. We value transparency, meritocracy, and a strong work ethic. Join our early team and help us build something exceptional.

Perks:

- Competitive salaries and stock options with substantial potential upside.
- Collaborate with top talent.
- Diverse and inclusive workspace.
- Comprehensive medical insurance for employees, spouses, and children.
- A culture celebrating every victory.
- Continuous learning and skill development opportunities.
- Enjoy good food, games, and a comfortable office environment.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Who We Are

At Bluehost, we believe all small businesses deserve the opportunity to succeed online. Our mission is to give small businesses the confidence to think big. We're the all-in-one platform for small businesses to grow online with powerful simplicity, premium performance, smart tools and human support.

This role is a part of Bluehost's innovation team, the group building the AI-native backbone of our platform while the rest of the business scales around us. You'll design async, production-grade backend systems that treat AI as a first-class citizen: multi-agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, and provider-agnostic LLM integration, all woven into products millions of small businesses depend on. We want a true go-getter who can take an idea from whiteboard to production without waiting to be told how.

What You'll Do & How You'll Make Your Mark

- Design and scale async REST/WebSocket APIs in Python (FastAPI or similar), using dependency injection, type hints, and clean, vertical-slice architecture 
- Implement multi-agent workflows (sequential, concurrent, and handoff patterns) to route work among specialized LLM agents 
- Integrate multiple LLM providers behind a provider-agnostic layer, enabling A/B testing and cost-aware routing rather than hard-coding a single vendor 
- Build and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines against vector stores such as pgvector, Chroma, or a managed vector search service 
- Design schemas and evolve data models (SQLAlchemy/SQLModel-style ORM plus migrations) that support both traditional application logic and AI-driven features 
- Instrument services with structured logs, distributed tracing, and cost/latency metrics, holding a real bar for p95 response time under production load 
- Maintain end-to-end CI/CD ownership, lint, type-check, test, package, and deploy, so releases are boring and safe 
- Champion AI across the delivery lifecycle, not just code generation, and set the guardrails the team works inside: how generated code gets reviewed, how provenance and licensing are checked, and what customer data may enter a prompt 
- Move ideas from concept to production fast, with real ownership over architecture and outcomes, not just tickets 

Who You Are & What You'll Need To Succeed

- 5+ years building production backend systems in Python, with real async I/O experience 
- Hands-on experience designing and scaling REST or async APIs, including dependency injection and clean service architecture 
- Practical experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, or similar) and building AI-readiness into backend systems from the ground up 
- Real experience with vector databases and RAG-style retrieval architectures, not just reading about them 
- Strong relational database skills: schema design, query optimization, and migration discipline 
- AI-augmented delivery: you use AI across the delivery lifecycle, not just code generation, and can say which models suit which problems and where you don't use them. You review AI-generated code knowing its failure modes, and you have set the guardrails others work inside — review expectations for generated code, provenance and licensing checks, and clear boundaries for what customer data enters a prompt and what a security or compliance review will ask for. 
- End-to-end CI/CD ownership, from build and test through packaging and deployment 
- A self-starting, go-getter mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration, and owning a problem until it's actually solved 
- Bonus: experience with multi-agent orchestration frameworks (Semantic Kernel, LangChain, or similar) and LLM cost/observability tooling 

Why You'll Love Us

- We’ve evolved: We provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work-from-home, hybrid, or work-from-the-office environment. 
- Work-life balance: Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well. 
- We celebrate one another’s differences: We’re proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20+ affinity groups where you can network and connect with employees globally. 
- We care about you: At Bluehost, taking care of our employees is our top priority. We make sure that cutting edge benefits are in place for you. Some of the benefits you will have: We have partnered with some of the best insurance providers to provide you excellent Health Insurance options, Education/ Certification Sponsorships to give you a chance to further your knowledge, Flexi-leaves to take personal time off and much more. Building a community with one domain at a time, one employee at a time.
- Where can we take you? We’re fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with Bluehost #OTOD!

title: Software Engineer II
description:
Job Description

About the Engineering Team

Chegg’s engineering team is a community of passionate builders who partner closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to shape the future of online learning. Grounded in Chegg’s core values—putting students first, acting with integrity, and holding a high bar for excellence—we build with care and accountability. As the world and our industry continue to evolve, we stay true to those principles: we invest in quality, design for scale and longevity, and avoid shortcuts (hello unit tests and documentation) so we can deliver reliable, high-impact experiences on time.

About The Role

We're hiring a Software Engineer II, Frontend to own the design, quality, and delivery of features across our student-facing web applications. This role is focused on building React/Next.js product experiences, the GraphQL-powered data layers behind them, and increasingly, AI-powered study features (step-by-step solutions, Q&A, and personalized study assistance). You will also contribute across the stack as needed — this is a frontend-first role with full-stack reach, and you should be comfortable enough with backend concepts and AWS infrastructure to ramp into our Java or Python backend services when a task calls for it.

What You'll Do

- Own frontend features end-to-end — architecture, implementation, testing, staged rollout, and production monitoring — across student-facing web application.
- Translate product requirements into component architecture, GraphQL query/schema boundaries, and client-state contracts (React Query, Redux Toolkit, or similar) that other engineers build on.
- Debug cross-system issues that surface in the UI — GraphQL supergraph errors, auth/session edge cases, server/client rendering mismatches — by tracing root cause across the stack.
- Build AI-powered study features responsibly: validate model output (e.g., step-by-step solutions, Q&A answers) before it reaches the UI, design graceful fallbacks for unusable or low-confidence responses, and instrument these flows with telemetry.
- Apply security and data-protection practices — input validation, secure auth/session handling, careful treatment of student data — as a default part of the code you ship, not a step someone else checks for.
- Optimize application performance (rendering strategy, bundle size, Core Web Vitals) as an ongoing part of feature work, particularly for high-traffic student study flows.
- Own the quality of your changes through automated tests (unit, component, and end-to-end), CI stability, and production validation.
- Partner closely with Product, Design, and Backend to deliver and harden high-impact student workflows (search, Q&A, subscription/paywall flows, study tools).
- Contribute to engineering quality through strong code reviews — including review of AI-generated code — reusable patterns, shared components, and clear documentation that keeps technical debt low.
- Ship end-to-end changes across the web application and its supporting APIs/schema, as needed.

Required Qualifications

- Most qualified candidates will likely bring 4+ years of professional frontend engineering experience building production web applications, with demonstrated ownership of features from design through launch.
- Strong hands-on experience with React and Next.js, and comfort working in TypeScript.
- Working knowledge of web fundamentals — common security pitfalls (XSS, CSRF, auth/session handling), performance (rendering strategy, bundle size, Core Web Vitals), and accessibility (WCAG/ARIA basics) — and the judgment to apply them without being told to.
- Experience designing and consuming APIs across common paradigms — GraphQL (schema design, codegen, querying), REST, and real-time protocols such as WebSockets — and working with at least one modern client-state approach (React Query, Redux Toolkit, or similar).
- Strong testing and release-validation discipline — unit/component testing (Vitest or Jest, React Testing Library) and end-to-end testing (Playwright or Cypress).
- Comfort using AI-assisted development tools responsibly, with the ability to explain, validate, and safely ship the code you produce.
- Sound understanding of data structures, algorithms, and general software design principles, applied pragmatically rather than academically.

Preferred Qualifications

- Working knowledge of AWS infrastructure concepts (compute, storage, networking, basic service architecture) and some Node.js backend exposure — enough of a foundation to ramp into our Java or Python backend services when needed.
- Experience with Auth0 or similar authentication providers in a Next.js application.
- Experience shipping AI-powered UI — streaming responses, structured output rendering, graceful handling of model failures. Experience contributing to shared component libraries or tooling used across multiple teams/repos.
- Familiarity with frontend observability tooling (New Relic or similar).
- Experience in EdTech, e-commerce, or another high-traffic, subscription-based consumer product company.

Tech Stack

- Frontend: React (18/19), Next.js, TypeScript, GraphQL (Apollo tooling, codegen against a shared supergraph), React Query / Redux Toolkit / Zustand, styled-components, MUI
- Backend (foundational): Node.js, AWS (compute/storage/networking basics) — enough to ramp into Kotlin/Java (Spring) or Python (FastAPI/Django) services owned by backend engineering
- Testing: Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright
- Auth / Delivery: Auth0, GitLab CI
- Observability: New Relic
- AI / ML: OpenAI, RAG, MCP, AWS Bedrock (via shared backend integrations)

Why do we exist?

Students are working harder than ever before to stabilize their future. Our recent research study called State of the Student shows that nearly 3 out of 4 students are working to support themselves through college and 1 in 3 students feel pressure to spend more than they can afford. We founded our business on provided affordable textbook rental options to address these issues. Since then, we’ve expanded our offerings to supplement many facets of higher educational learning through Chegg Study, Chegg Math, Chegg Writing, Chegg Internships, Chegg Skills, and more to support students beyond their college experience. These offerings lower financial concerns for students by modernizing their learning experience. We exist so students everywhere have a smarter, faster, more affordable way to student.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
The Company
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Meet our team

Every time a PayPal customer checks out, signs up or moves money, a decision gets made in milliseconds. Enterprise Decision Management (EDM) is the platform that makes those decisions. We build the engine that teams across PayPal use to write, test and ship decision logic. Changes go live in hours, not release cycles, at a scale few companies ever see.

EDM is growing fast. More teams and use cases move onto the platform every quarter, and we're building out our engineering hub in Bangalore to match. You'll work side by side with colleagues in San Jose and Shanghai on high-throughput, low-latency systems, from the authoring experience to the rule engine running in production across multiple clouds and the insights that show how every decision performs. On this platform a decision is the product, your code sits on PayPal's critical path, and the problems get bigger as we grow. Come help build what's next.

As the Frontend Engineering Lead, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our global platform’s user experience. Working full-time out of our Gurugram office, this is a hybrid leadership role. You will spend 60% of your time leading, mentoring, and scaling an in-office team of engineers, driving sprint planning, and collaborating directly with Product and Design. Engineering Management & Mentorship (60%)

Technical Leadership & Architecture (40%)

Technical Stack:
- Core Frontend: ReactJS, VueJS, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3/Sass.
- DevOps & Cloud: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS (EC2, S3, CloudFront, EKS).

Requirements & Qualifications:
- Experience: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 1-2 years in a tech lead or people management capacity.

***Sr. Software Developer - J51005***

  

**Role & responsibilities**

Shift 8.30 pm 4 PM

Software Engineer (AI-assisted development)

Phone Manager is the platform we use to run our telecom business. Internal staff and resellers use it to manage numbers, carrier orders, messaging, PBX domains and billing across many reseller tenants. The foundation (Laravel API, Nuxt UI, Docker stack) is built. Claude Code now writes most new features. Our job is to direct it well: write the spec, steer the agent, review what it produces, and keep improving the harness (project rules, guidelines, skills, hooks) so each feature comes out right with less correction.

What you`ll do  
• Turn requests from operations, billing and support into specs the agent can build from, then drive them to a tested, merged PR.  
• Review AI-written code critically. Look for wrong assumptions, data leaking between resellers, missing tests and solutions that are bigger than they need to be.  
• Check the work against reality: carrier and PBX APIs with no sandbox, unusual failure modes and production logs.  
• When the agent gets something wrong, turn the lesson into a rule, guideline, skill or hook so it doesn`t happen again.  
What you`ll need  
• Solid Laravel and Vue/Nuxt experience: enough to judge code you didn`t type, and to take over when the agent can`t finish.  
• Real experience building with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar), and opinions on what makes them reliable.  
• Clear written English. Most of the job is writing specs, rules and PR descriptions.  
• Comfort working with unreliable third-party APIs and multi-tenant permission models

title: PMTS- Backend Engineering Professional
description:
We are looking for a Principal Member of Technical Staff (PMTS) to design, build and own the backend

services and distributed systems that power our energy and IoT platform. This is a backend-first role:

the PMTS will write production code every week, shape the architecture of high-throughput, eventdriven services, and take those services all the way to production on AWS and Kubernetes.

This is a deeply hands-on senior individual contributor role. It requires very strong backend

engineering, because that is where most of the work is; strong distributed systems depth, because our platform processes real-time telemetry at scale; and strong hands-on DevOps capability with AWS, Docker and Kubernetes, because engineers here own what they build through to production rather thanhanding it over. This is an AI-native engineering environment: AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Cursor are part of the daily workflow, and the PMTS will set the standard for how AI-assisted changes are reviewed. The role requires 8+ years of relevant experience.

Key Responsibilities

Backend Engineering (Hands-on)

- Design, build and ship production-grade backend services in Java, Spring Boot, Python and Go,

writing a significant share of the code yourself.

- Design APIs, data models and service contracts with versioning, failure semantics and scaling

paths considered up front.

- Own performance of services end to end: profiling, query optimisation, caching, connection

management and memory behaviour.

- Set and enforce standards for code quality, automated testing (unit, integration and contract) and

code review.

- Modernise legacy services incrementally without disrupting production.

- Choose the right technology for the problem rather than defaulting to a familiar stack.

Distributed Systems Data

- Design and build event-driven and streaming systems on Kafka, MQTT and Apache Flink for highthroughput IoT telemetry.

- Make deliberate trade-offs on consistency, ordering, partitioning, idempotency and delivery

guarantees

.Build for failure: retries with backoff, circuit breaking, backpressure, graceful degradation and safe

replay.

- Design data storage across PostgreSQL, Redis and time-series databases for scale, retention and

query patterns.

- Debug hard problems across service, database, messaging and network layers.

DevOps, AWS Kubernetes

- Containerise services with Docker and own their deployment on Kubernetes, including manifests,

Helm, autoscaling, resource limits and health checks.

- Design and operate AWS infrastructure for the services you build, with ownership of architecture,

security and cost.

- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with automated testing, safe database migrations and rollback.

- Write infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) held to the same review and versioning

standards as application code.

- Instrument services with metrics, structured logs and tracing so problems are visible before

customers report them.

- Own what you ship in production, including incident resolution and fixing root causes in code.

Architecture Technical Leadership

- Own architecture for backend services and set technical direction through design reviews, RFCs

and working code rather than mandate.

- Take ambiguous problems from definition through design, implementation and testing to production.

- Document consequential technical decisions, including trade-offs and the options deliberately

rejected.

- Mentor engineers on backend design, distributed systems and production ownership, and unblock

teams on hard technical problems.

- Use Claude Code, Cursor and equivalent AI coding agents in daily work, and define the review standards for AI-assisted changes.

Technology Environment

- Backend: Java, Spring Boot, Python, Django, FastAPI, Go.

- Messaging Streaming: Kafka, MQTT, Apache Flink and event-driven architectures.

- Data: PostgreSQL, Redis and time-series databases.

- Cloud: AWS.

- Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm and Terraform.

- CI/CD: GitHub Actions or equivalent modern CI/CD tooling.

- Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry and Sentry.

- APIs Contracts: REST, OpenAPI and AsyncAPI.

- Frontend: React and TypeScript (working knowledge).

- AI Tooling: Claude Code, Cursor and LLM APIs.

Qualifications Experience

Essential: Backend Engineering

- 8+ years of software engineering experience, the majority in hands-on backend development of production systems.

- Deep expertise in Java/Spring Boot or Python (Django/FastAPI), writing production-quality code

every week rather than only reviewing it.

- Strong API design, data modelling and SQL skills, including schema and query optimisation.

- Solid testing discipline, with unit, integration and contract tests as part of normal delivery.

Essential: Distributed Systems

- Proven track record designing, building and running distributed systems in production at scale.

- Hands-on experience with Kafka or equivalent messaging and event-driven architecture.

- Strong grasp of concurrency, consistency, partitioning, idempotency and failure handling.

- Exceptional debugging ability across service, database, messaging and network layers.

Essential: DevOps, AWS Kubernetes

- Hands-on production experience on AWS across compute, networking, storage, managed databases and IAM.

- Strong Docker fundamentals and hands-on Kubernetes experience deploying, scaling and troubleshooting services in production.

- CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code built and maintained first-hand rather than inherited.

- Practical observability experience with metrics, logging, tracing and alerting.

Essential: Leadership Ways of Working

- Track record of technical influence beyond personal output: standards adopted, teams unblocked and engineers levelled up.

- Ability to work independently with ambiguous requirements and bring clarity to others.

- Strong written communication across design documents, RFCs, post-mortems and runbooks.

- Bias towards owning outcomes rather than tickets, and towards fixing causes rather than symptoms.

- Fluent use of Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent AI development tools in daily engineering work.

Desirable

- IoT, energy, industrial or real-time data experience.

- Apache Flink, MQTT or time-series databases (ClickHouse, InfluxDB) at scale.

- Go in production.

- React and TypeScript working knowledge.

- Experience building LLM-powered or Agentic AI features in production.

- Experience in high-velocity product or startup environments.

Engineering at Innovaccer

With every line of code, we accelerate our customers success, turning complex challenges into innovative solutions. Collaboratively, we transform each data point we gather into valuable insights for our customers. Join us and be part of a team thats turning dreams of better healthcare into reality, one line of code at a time. Together, were shaping the future and making a meaningful impact on the world.

About the Role

Were looking for a

**Software Development Engineer - II**

to build the most amazing product experience at Innovaccer. Youll work closely with other engineers to build delightful feature experiences that understand and solve our customers pain points - across backend systems, identity, and the abstractions that hold them together.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who combines strong backend fundamentals with a bias for ownership - taking a feature from prototype to production, and caring as much about how its built as what it does.

A Day in the Life Engineering Development

* Build efficient, reusable applications and abstractions across backend and identity systems.
* Own the full project lifecycle - from prototyping through design, build, integration, QA, and delivery.
* Automate repetitive workflows to boost team efficiency.

Reliability Best Practices

* Improve the performance, reliability, observability, scalability, stability, and security of the product.
* Identify and drive adoption of back-end best practices.
* Raise engineering standards through code reviews, tooling, and process improvements.

Collaboration Ownership

* Navigate ambiguous requirements by leading discussions with stakeholders and team members.

What You Need

**Must-Haves**

* 3+ years of experience with a start-up mentality and a high willingness to learn.
* Expert in Python, Go, or Java, with experience in a relevant web framework.
* Aggressive problem diagnosis and creative problem-solving skills.
* Expert in Kubernetes and containerization.
* Experience with RDBMS and NoSQL databases such as Postgres and MongoDB.
* Experience in Solution Architecture.
* Experience with cloud service providers such as AWS or Azure.
* Bachelors degree in Computer Science / Software Engineering.
* Go-get-done, bias-for-action, self-starter, and team-player attitude.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with any OLAP database.
* Experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, or other queuing services.
* Working experience with Distributed Systems / multi-tenant systems and Async Programming.

**Here s What We Offer**

* Generous Leaves: Enjoy generous leave benefits of up to 40 days.
* Parental Leave: Leverage one of industrys best parental leave policies to spend time with your new addition.
* Sabbatical: Want to focus on skill development, pursue an academic career, or just take a break Weve got you covered.
* Health Insurance: We offer comprehensive health insurance to support you and your family, covering medical expenses related to illness, disease, or injury. Extending support to the family members who matter most.
* Care Program: Whether it s a celebration or a time of need, we ve got you covered with care vouchers to mark major life events. Through our Care Vouchers program, employees receive thoughtful gestures for significant personal milestones and moments of need.
* Financial Assistance: Life happens, and when it does, we re here to help. Our financial assistance policy offers support through salary advances and personal loans for genuine personal needs, ensuring help is there when you need it most.

**Disclaimer:** Innovaccer does not charge fees or require payment from individuals or agencies for securing employment with us. We do not guarantee job spots or engage in any financial transactions related to employment. If you encounter any posts or requests asking for payment or personal information, we strongly advise you to report them immediately to our HR department at px@ . Additionally, please exercise caution and verify the authenticity of any requests before disclosing personal and confidential information, including bank account details.

About Innovaccer

Innovaccer builds software that helps hospitals, clinics, and health insurance companies make sense of all the scattered data they deal with every day - patient records, appointments, insurance claims, lab results - and turns it into something useful and actionable.

Think of a typical hospital: patient information often lives in a dozen different systems that dont talk to each other well. This causes delays in scheduling, slows down doctors, and makes it harder to catch health problems early. Innovaccers platform connects all of that data together, and increasingly, uses AI "agents" to actually do some of the manual work for healthcare teams - things like scheduling appointments, preparing insurance paperwork, or drafting clinical notes - so that staff can spend more time with patients and less time on admin work.

Some of the largest healthcare systems in the US - including CommonSpirit Health, Atlantic Health, and Banner Health - use Innovaccers platform today.

The company is also investing heavily in this direction: in June 2026, Innovaccer signed a multi-year partnership with AWS to run its AI agents at a much larger scale, using AWSs cloud AI tools (Amazon Bedrock) and healthcare-specific data infrastructure (AWS HealthLake). This is a strong signal of where the platform - and this engineering team - is headed next. For more information, visit www. and check us out on YouTube , Glassdoor , LinkedIn , Instagram , and the Web .
