title: Senior Software Developer
description:
**Team:** Engineering

**Products:** Practice management and out-of-network reimbursement software

**Company Description** Thapovan Info Systems Inc. is an IT consulting and software development company serving small and medium businesses across the globe. The organization has expanded into knowledge process outsourcing (KPO) for the financial industry, offering specialized technology services to this sector. Thapovan is technology-driven and process-oriented, focusing on quality delivery and long-term partnerships. Team members work across a spectrum of modern technologies and niche domains, gaining exposure to diverse projects and industry challenges.

**About the Opportunity** Thapovan Info Systems is hiring on behalf of a client that builds software for private practices and their clients. The client's work spans two products:

The first product is a practice-management platform with practitioner and client portals, clinic administration tools, APIs, and newer cloud-based services for insurance workflows.

The second product helps practices get patients reimbursed for out-of-network care. Practitioners file claims, run verification-of-benefits checks, manage patients and billing, and share eligibility results. The same flows also run from a patient website widget, a mobile app, partner integrations, and background jobs that check coverage when a claim is filed.

Both products handle real claim, member, patient, and practice data, so the work has to stay correct, reliable, and secure.

**Role Description** We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and operate features across both products. You will own features from the practitioner screen through the API and the data behind it, partnering with product and design to turn customer needs into dependable software. You will spend most of your time in existing Node and React code, and you will read and change PHP and Python services when a feature crosses those boundaries.

This is a senior individual-contributor role. You will lead design on the features you take, review other engineers' changes, mentor teammates, and keep sensitive data out of logs, fixtures, and tests. We value depth in at least one area and the curiosity to work across a varied platform. Modernizing technology is not an end in itself; we favor thoughtful, scoped improvements to existing systems alongside the building of new services.

**What You'll Do**

* Design, build, test, and maintain user-facing features, APIs, and platform services across both products, from the practitioner UI through the API to the database.
* Build and change practitioner flows: filing claims, verifying benefits, patient and practice management, billing and plan limits, and partner or background checks that reuse the same eligibility result.
* Implement HTTP APIs with validation, authentication, services, and MySQL access, so the same behavior is available to the portal, mobile app, and partner callers.
* Keep eligibility behavior consistent across the portal, patient widget, mobile summary, partner API, and claim-submission job. A check started in one channel must mean the same thing in the others.
* Change legacy PHP and Python services when account, claim, cache, queue, or shared behavior still lives there, using judgement about what to change in place and what to leave alone.
* Help shape technical designs and make pragmatic decisions about architecture, reliability, and maintainability.
* Work across frontend, back end, data, and cloud infrastructure where the problem calls for it.
* Improve performance, observability, security, and operational readiness, and support safe changes to data models, integrations, and production systems.
* Add or update automated tests for behavior changes. Tests should describe the rule, not copy the implementation line by line.
* Review pull requests for correctness, security, and fit with existing patterns, and mentor engineers who are newer to the billing and eligibility rules.
* Collaborate with product and design to clarify requirements and surface trade-offs.
* Run features locally in Docker and through the existing delivery pipeline: unit tests, SonarQube, build, and deploy.

**What You'll Bring**

* 4+ years building and supporting production web applications as an individual contributor, including at least 2 years owning features across a React UI and a Node API.
* Strong JavaScript and Node.js. You can debug an Express route from the handler through the service and the SQL.
* Practical React experience: forms, routing, client state, and accessible UI in a large existing codebase.
* Solid MySQL skills. You write queries you can explain, and you notice when a change will lock or scan too much.
* Experience with authentication (JWT or Amazon Cognito) and with keeping secrets and personal data out of code and logs.
* Experience designing maintainable software and working with APIs, relational data, and automated tests.
* A practical approach to debugging, code review, technical trade-offs, and incremental delivery.
* A habit of reading the code that is already there and extending it, including older PHP when a feature requires it.
* Clear written and verbal communication across engineering and product, especially in pull requests and design notes where a billing or eligibility rule has more than one caller.
* Care for user privacy, data protection, and the reliability of systems that handle sensitive information. Synthetic values only in tests, logs, and fixtures.
* Willingness to learn unfamiliar parts of the platform and contribute beyond a single codebase.

**Our Technical Environment**

**Frontend** React (including React 16 and React/TypeScript apps), React Router, Material UI, Redux, React Hook Form, Webpack

**Node services** Node.js, Express, Joi, Jest, Winston; TypeScript services built with NestJS

**Cloud and serverless** AWS (Cognito, S3, SDK, Lambda), CDK

**Legacy and other APIs** PHP 8.3 with Phalcon 5 and Apache; Python/Tornado APIs backed by SQL databases

**Data and messaging** MySQL, Redis, RabbitMQ

**Payments and billing** Stripe, Stax, Staxbill

**Delivery** Docker, Jest, ESLint, SonarQube, shared packages and monorepo tooling alongside separately maintained applications

You do not need to match every item. We value strong engineering fundamentals over a full checklist.

**Helpful Experience**

* Healthcare, insurance, payments, or other privacy-sensitive domains: claims, eligibility (270/271 or a clearinghouse), superbills, practice management, or subscription billing.
* PHP in a legacy API, with judgment about what to change in place and what to leave alone.
* Redis, queues, and background jobs that must stay idempotent.
* AWS services, serverless systems, Docker-based local development, or infrastructure as code.
* Partner or multi-tenant APIs where one practice's limits and data must not leak into another's.
* Improving or extending established applications while preserving their architecture; supporting integrations, payment flows, or data migrations.

**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Computer Science, including data structures, algorithms, software design principles, and system architecture.
* Proficiency in software engineering fundamentals, including object-oriented programming (OOP), design patterns, and writing maintainable, reusable code.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex business requirements into practical and reliable technical solutions.
* Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), engineering best practices, and quality assurance principles.
* Experience with modern development methodologies, collaborative workflows, version control, and continuous integration practices.
* Ability to analyze complex technical problems, evaluate alternatives, and make sound engineering decisions.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience in consulting, client-facing engineering, or working across multiple domains and technology environments.
* Exposure to healthcare, insurance, financial services, or other regulated or privacy-sensitive industries.

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. title: Software Development Engineer - IV (QC08966)
description:
**Software Development Engineer – IV**
======================================

### **Technical Leadership | People Leadership | Aereo Cloud**

**About Aereo**
---------------

Aereo (earlier known as Aarav Unmanned Systems) is a deep-tech company building the future of how the physical world is mapped, understood and managed.

We build end-to-end drone and geospatial intelligence solutions for enterprises and governments across mining & metals, infrastructure, energy, utilities, urban planning and other large-scale industries.

Our technology brings together aerial robotics, computer vision, GIS, AI and cloud software to solve complex, real-world problems at scale. We are backed by leading Indian VCs and have built a self-sustaining, rapidly growing business with a strong presence in the commercial drone ecosystem.

At Aereo, we believe in solving meaningful problems, moving with urgency, and building technology that creates measurable impact.

**About Aereo Cloud**
---------------------

Aereo Cloud is the technology backbone of our geospatial intelligence ecosystem and our enterprise SaaS platform.

The platform enables organizations to securely store, manage, visualize and analyze massive volumes of drone and geospatial data, turning complex spatial data into actionable insights and enterprise workflows.

With workloads operating at PB-scale, Aereo Cloud brings together large-scale data processing, geospatial visualization, analytics and enterprise workflows. As our customer base and use cases grow, we're solving increasingly complex problems around scale, performance, reliability and engineering velocity.

We are looking for a **Software Development Engineer – IV** to help lead this next phase of engineering at Aereo Cloud.

**The Role**
============

This is a **senior engineering leadership role combining strong technical ownership with people leadership**.

You will lead a team of engineers across one or more key areas of Aereo Cloud while remaining deeply connected to the technical problems the team is solving.

We are looking for someone who has grown from a strong software engineering background into technical and people leadership, someone who can **design systems, challenge technical decisions, solve complex engineering problems and still get hands-on when required**, while simultaneously building, mentoring and developing a high-performing engineering team.

You won't be expected to spend your days writing code. But you also won't be expected to step away from engineering.

You should be comfortable getting into the details - reviewing designs and code, debugging difficult production issues, prototyping solutions, driving architectural decisions and contributing to critical implementations when needed.

At the same time, you will be responsible for building a team where engineers take ownership, grow in their careers, develop strong technical judgment and consistently raise the engineering bar.

**We are not looking for someone who has moved away from engineering into management. We are looking for an engineer who has grown into leadership.**

**What You'll Do**
==================

**1. Technical Leadership**
---------------------------

* Own the technical direction of your engineering area, aligned with Aereo Cloud's product and business priorities.
* Lead architecture and system design for scalable, reliable and maintainable services and platforms.
* Make pragmatic engineering decisions across scalability, performance, reliability, security, cost and engineering velocity.
* Break down ambiguous and complex problems into clear technical approaches and executable plans.
* Review technical designs, RFCs and critical code changes, raising the quality of engineering decisions across the team.
* Stay close enough to the codebase to understand how systems actually work and where they can fail.
* Dive into complex technical and production problems when the team needs deeper technical expertise.
* Prototype or contribute to implementation for critical, technically challenging or high-leverage problems.
* Identify architectural gaps and technical debt that could limit Aereo Cloud's ability to scale, and drive initiatives to address them.
* Establish and continuously improve engineering standards, development practices and technical guidelines.
* Raise the bar on testing, CI/CD, observability, performance optimisation and production reliability.

**2. Engineering Execution**
----------------------------

* Own delivery of business-critical engineering initiatives from problem definition through production.
* Translate product requirements and customer problems into clear technical priorities and execution plans.
* Work closely with Product, Design and other engineering teams to make effective technical and product trade-offs.
* Build strong engineering execution rhythms without creating unnecessary process.
* Identify bottlenecks in development, architecture and delivery and continuously improve how the team works.
* Balance short-term product requirements with long-term platform scalability and technical health.
* Take ownership of production health for your area, including reliability, incidents, performance, bugs and root-cause analysis.
* Drive proactive capacity planning, observability and identification of production risks.
* Ensure learnings from incidents and failures translate into lasting engineering improvements.

**3. People Leadership & Team Development**
-------------------------------------------

* Lead, mentor and develop a high-performing engineering team with a strong culture of ownership and technical excellence.
* Conduct regular 1:1s and provide clear, thoughtful and actionable feedback.
* Understand the strengths, development areas and aspirations of individual engineers and help them grow.
* Coach engineers towards greater technical ownership, independence and decision-making.
* Identify high-potential engineers and develop them into future technical leaders.
* Set clear expectations, goals and measurable outcomes for team members.
* Create an environment where engineers can challenge ideas, take ownership, experiment and learn from failures.
* Maintain a high bar for engineering quality while creating psychological safety for healthy technical debate.
* Support engineers through technical and professional challenges and help them become increasingly effective.
* Take responsibility for performance management, including recognising strong performance and addressing performance gaps.
* Participate actively in hiring, interviewing and onboarding engineering talent.
* Identify capability gaps within the team and work with engineering leadership to build the capabilities required for Aereo Cloud's growth.

**4. Product & Business Impact**
--------------------------------

* Understand the customer and business context behind the problems Aereo Cloud is solving.
* Help engineers connect technical decisions to customer outcomes and business impact.
* Partner closely with Product, Design, Business and customer-facing teams to understand complex problems.
* Influence product and engineering roadmaps through strong technical judgment and a deep understanding of the platform.
* Identify opportunities where engineering investments can unlock new product capabilities or improve customer experience.
* Make thoughtful trade-offs between speed, quality, scalability and long-term technical sustainability.

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

**Must Have**
-------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* **6+ years of software engineering experience** building and operating production-grade systems.
* Meaningful experience providing **technical leadership and/or people leadership** to a team of engineers.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production systems at scale.
* Strong understanding of **system design, distributed systems, microservices, APIs, databases and cloud-native architectures**.
* Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages such as **Python, Java, TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, Java, Go or similar**.
* Experience designing systems with considerations around scalability, performance, reliability and security.
* Demonstrated ability to take technically ambiguous problems from definition through execution and production.
* Experience mentoring engineers and helping them develop greater technical ownership.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across Engineering, Product, Design and Business teams.
* A strong sense of ownership and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience leading or managing a team of **5+ engineers**.
* Experience working in a product or SaaS company.
* Experience owning or significantly influencing a product or engineering roadmap.
* Experience working with large-scale, data-intensive or distributed systems.
* Experience with AWS, GCP or Azure and modern cloud-native technologies.
* Familiarity with containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability and infrastructure-as-code.
* Experience working with high-volume data processing, analytics or data platforms.
* Experience with geospatial, GIS, mapping, imagery, computer vision or other spatial/data-heavy applications.
* Experience balancing technical debt, product velocity and long-term architectural investments.
* Experience hiring and developing engineers into technical leadership roles.
* Experience working in engineering teams where engineers have significant ownership of technical and product decisions.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

In this role, success isn't simply measured by whether the team delivers its roadmap.

**You should leave the engineering organisation stronger than you found it.**

Within your first 6–12 months, we expect you to:

* Build a high-trust, high-accountability engineering team.
* Develop engineers into stronger technical owners and future leaders.
* Improve the quality and consistency of technical decision-making.
* Drive meaningful improvements in architecture, reliability and engineering velocity.
* Take ownership of critical technical initiatives and see them through to production.
* Build strong collaboration between Engineering, Product and Business.
* Establish a culture where engineers are encouraged to think deeply, challenge assumptions and own outcomes.
* Become someone engineers actively seek out when they face difficult technical problems.

The goal is not to be the person who has all the answers.

**The goal is to build a team that becomes significantly better because you're there.**

**Why Aereo**
=============

You will work on genuinely complex engineering problems at the intersection of **cloud software, geospatial intelligence, aerial robotics and large-scale data**.

Aereo Cloud processes massive volumes of drone and spatial data and is becoming the digital backbone through which enterprises understand and manage physical assets across mining, infrastructure, energy and other industrial environments.

You'll have the opportunity to influence both **the technology we're building and the engineers who build it**.

If you've grown from a strong software engineer into someone who enjoys **solving hard technical problems, building scalable systems, mentoring engineers and taking ownership of teams and outcomes**, this is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in building the next generation of Aereo Cloud.

title: Technical Lead (QC08923)
description:
**About Aereo**

  

**Aereo** (earlier known as Aarav Unmanned Systems) is a deep-tech company building the future of how the physical world is mapped, understood and managed.

  

We build end-to-end drone and geospatial intelligence solutions for enterprises and governments across mining & metals, infrastructure, energy, utilities, urban planning and other large-scale industries.

  

Our technology brings together aerial robotics, computer vision, GIS, AI and cloud software to solve complex, real-world problems at scale.

  

**About Aereo Cloud**

Aereo Cloud is our enterprise SaaS platform and the technology backbone of our geospatial intelligence ecosystem.The platform enables organizations to securely store, manage, visualize and analyze massive volumes of drone and geospatial data, turning complex spatial data into actionable insights and workflows.

With workloads operating at PB-scale, Aereo Cloud brings together large-scale data processing, geospatial visualization, analytics and enterprise workflows.

  

We are looking for a **Technical Lead** to help lead the next phase of engineering at Aereo Cloud.

  

**The Role**

This is a **senior engineering leadership role combining technical ownership with people leadership.**You will lead a team of engineers across key areas of Aereo Cloud while remaining deeply involved in the technical problems the team is solving.

  

We are looking for someone who has grown from a strong software engineering background into technical and people leadership - **someone who can design systems, make architectural decisions, solve complex engineering problems and get hands-on when required,** while building and developing a high-performing engineering team.

  

You won't be expected to code all day, but you also won't be expected to step away from engineering. You should be comfortable reviewing designs and code, debugging production issues, prototyping solutions and contributing to critical implementations when needed.

  

**We are not looking for someone who has moved away from engineering into management. We are looking for an engineer who has grown into leadership.**

  

**What You'll Do**

  

**Technical Leadership & Engineering**

* Own the technical direction and architecture of your engineering area.
  

* Lead system design and make pragmatic decisions across scalability, performance, reliability, security and cost.
  

* Break down complex, ambiguous problems into clear technical approaches and execution plans.
  

* Review designs, RFCs and critical code, and raise the engineering bar across the team.
  

* Stay close to the codebase and dive into complex technical or production problems when required.
  

* Contribute to implementation, prototyping or debugging for critical and high-leverage problems.
  

* Drive improvements across engineering standards, testing, CI/CD, observability and production reliability.
  

* Own critical engineering initiatives from problem definition through production.
  

**People Leadership**

* Lead, mentor and develop a high-performing engineering team.
  

* Conduct regular 1:1s, provide actionable feedback and support engineers in their career growth.
  

* Develop engineers into stronger technical owners and future technical leaders.
  

* Set clear expectations and maintain a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement.
  

* Identify and address performance and capability gaps within the team.
  

* Participate actively in hiring, interviewing and onboarding engineering talent.
  

**Product & Business Impact**

* Partner with Product, Design and Business teams to translate customer problems into effective technical solutions.
  

* Influence product and engineering roadmaps through strong technical judgment.
  

* Balance product velocity with scalability, reliability and long-term technical health.
  

* Help engineers connect their technical work to customer and business outcomes.
  

**What We're Looking For**

**Must Have**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  

* **6+ years of software engineering experience** building and operating production-grade systems.
  

* Meaningful experience in **technical leadership and/or people management.**
  

* Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building scalable production systems.
  

* Strong understanding of **system design, distributed systems, microservices, APIs, databases and cloud-native architectures.**
  

* Strong proficiency in one or more languages such as **Python, Java, TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, Java, Go** or similar.
  

* Experience designing systems with a focus on scalability, performance, reliability and security.
  

* Ability to take ambiguous technical problems from definition through execution and production.
  

* Experience mentoring engineers and developing greater technical ownership within a team.
  

* Strong communication, ownership and problem-solving skills.
  

**Preferred**

* Experience leading or managing a team of **5+ engineers.**
  

* Experience in a **product or SaaS company.**
  

* Experience owning or significantly influencing a product or engineering roadmap.
  

* Experience with large-scale, data-intensive or distributed systems.
  

* Experience with AWS, GCP or Azure and modern cloud-native technologies.
  

* Familiarity with Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability and infrastructure-as-code.
  

* Experience with high-volume data processing, analytics or data platforms.
  

* Experience with geospatial, GIS, mapping, imagery, computer vision or other spatial/data-heavy applications.
  

* Experience hiring and developing engineers into technical leadership roles.
  

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means leaving the engineering organisation stronger than you found it.

  

**Within your first 6–12 months, you should:**

* Build a high-performing, accountable engineering team.
  

* Develop engineers into stronger technical owners and future leaders.
  

* Improve technical decision-making, engineering quality and execution.
  

* Drive meaningful improvements in architecture, reliability and engineering velocity.
  

* Own and deliver critical technical initiatives.
  

* Become someone engineers actively seek out when they face difficult technical problems.
  

**Why Aereo**

  

You will work on complex engineering problems at the **intersection of cloud software, geospatial intelligence, aerial robotics and large-scale data.**

  

Aereo Cloud processes massive volumes o**f drone and spatial data and enables enterprises across mining, infrastructure, energy and other industries** to understand and manage physical assets.

  

You'll have the **opportunity to influence both the technology we're building and the engineers who build it.**

  

If you've grown **from a strong software engineer into someone who enjoys solving hard technical problems, building scalable systems, mentoring engineers and taking ownership of teams and outcomes,** this is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in building the next generation of Aereo Cloud

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (MERN)
description:
**Own what you build, from first commit to long after go-live.**

Anyone can ship a feature. What sets great engineers apart is what happens next: whether the system holds when traffic doubles overnight, how fast it recovers when something breaks, and whether the client’s product is still thriving a year on.

Techdome designs and runs production-grade platforms for clients in FinTech, Healthcare, E-commerce, SaaS, Logistics, and EdTech. The domains change, but the bar doesn’t: secure, reliable, and ready to scale. We’re looking for a Senior MERN Stack Developer to build full-stack products with MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js (TypeScript), and to stay accountable for them well beyond launch.

### **What your role looks like**

* **Take features from idea to live:** Drive work through design, build, release, and ongoing support, and remain the owner afterward.
* **Build products that hold up under load:** Create polished React interfaces and secure, well-tested Node/Express APIs on top of thoughtfully modeled MongoDB data.
* **Set the standard for quality:** Run constructive code reviews and champion readable, tested, maintainable code.
* **Keep a steady hand when things break:** Lead the response to incidents, restore service fast, and follow through with root-cause analysis so issues stay fixed.
* **Shape how our platforms evolve:** Help make the architecture and design decisions that matter.
* **Grow the people around you:** Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and raise the team’s overall skill.
* **Work as one team with product, design, QA, and DevOps:** Get hands-on with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, containers, and observability.
* **See the world through the client’s eyes:** Quickly understand each client’s users, goals, and constraints, and turn them into the right technical solutions.

### **Your first 90 days**

* **Days 1–30, Learn and deliver:** Get to know our codebases, tools, and people, and ship your first meaningful contribution.
* **Days 31–60, Own something real:** Take a feature or service end to end, and add your voice to code reviews and design discussions.
* **Days 61–90, Become the go-to person:** Be a dependable engineer on a core client product, handle production issues confidently, and start guiding teammates.

### **What you bring**

* 4+ years building full-stack web applications professionally
* Deep MERN expertise (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js) with strong JavaScript and TypeScript
* Solid grounding in REST API design, MongoDB schema design and indexing, authentication and authorization, testing, and application security
* Experience with React state management and performance tuning (Redux, React Query, code splitting, etc.)
* A history of *running* production systems, not only building them
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
* Comfort with Git, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and production monitoring and debugging
* Experience across different industries or product types, and the ability to ramp up fast on new domains
* A natural tendency to step up and take ownership when it’s needed

### **Bonus points**

* Strong system design skills: microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architecture
* Experience with Next.js, GraphQL, or WebSockets/real-time features
* Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code experience
* Familiarity with compliance standards such as HIPAA, PCI-DSS, GDPR, or SOC 2
* Experience integrating third-party services like payment gateways (Stripe, Braintree, Adyen), CRMs, or analytics tools
* Background in a consultancy or product studio juggling multiple clients and projects
* Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot

### **Why you’ll like it here**

* **Independent and profitable:** No investor pressure or growth-at-any-cost targets. We play the long game.
* **A truly global team:** Collaborate with 80+ engineers across five hubs worldwide.
* **Variety built in:** Different industries and products keep your skills sharp.
* **A voice that counts:** You’ll influence our technical direction, and your role goes well beyond closing tickets.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are seeking a Software Engineer (.NET) to join our Product Engineering team and help drive the modernization of our Retail ERP platform. You will build and test backend services and RESTful APIs for business areas of the ERP, working alongside a Technical Lead who owns the area's design.

**Required Technical Skills**
-----------------------------

### **Core Technologies**

* 2–5 years of hands-on experience in software development using C# and .NET Core (.NET 6/8 or above).
* Good experience developing RESTful APIs.
* **Good understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, SOLID principles, and common Design Patterns.**
* Experience with Entity Framework Core or Dapper.
* Working knowledge of asynchronous programming, Dependency Injection, and Middleware.

### **Database**

* Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL or SQL Server.
* Good SQL skills: joins, indexing, transactions, and basic query tuning.

### **Testing & Quality**

* Experience writing unit tests with xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest.
* Understanding of integration and API testing.

### **Cloud & DevOps**

* Exposure to Microsoft Azure or similar cloud platforms.
* Basic knowledge of Docker and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps).

### **AI-assisted Development**

* Comfortable using AI coding tools (e.g. Claude, Codex, GitHub Copilot) in daily development.

### **Version Control**

* Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

**Team Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Take ownership of assigned modules and deliver them to agreed quality and timelines.
* Participate in code reviews, giving and taking feedback.
* Collaborate with QA, DevOps, and other teams to resolve issues quickly.
* Share knowledge and document your work for the team.

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

* Exposure to Domain-Driven Design or microservices.
* Experience with Kafka or similar messaging platforms.
* Experience with OpenAPI / Swagger.
* Exposure to retail, ERP, supply chain, warehouse management, or POS systems is highly desirable.

**Educational Qualification**
-----------------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

**What You'll Work On**
-----------------------

* Enterprise Retail ERP Platform
* Inventory & Warehouse Management
* Procurement & Supply Chain Solutions
* Order Management Systems
* API-first Integrations
* Event-Driven Architecture
* Multi-tenant Platform Development
* High-volume Transaction Processing
* Cloud-native Modernization Initiatives
* Performance and Scalability Engineering

**What We Look For**
--------------------

* Strong hands-on coding skills.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to understand existing code and business rules quickly.
* Passion for clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.
* Ownership mindset and willingness to learn.
* Good communication and teamwork.

**Why Join Us**
---------------

* Opportunity to modernize a large-scale enterprise Retail ERP platform.
* Work on cloud-native, event-driven, and distributed systems.
* Solve challenging scalability and performance problems.
* Collaborate with experienced architects and product engineering teams.
* Play a key role in shaping the technical direction of a mission-critical product.
